verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), machine-readable Markdown docs and llms.txt, starter template repos, and step-by-step guides. None of it documents an interactive API reference or explorer with runnable, in-browser examples. A raw spec and starter repos are building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
